venueAddress:
Nestled in the  secluded Kromdraai valley on Sterkfontein Cave Rd in Krugesdorp, built on a 50 hectare estate, lies our beautiful and exclusive venue in south africa's well known world heritage sites. 

The river meanders under big old trees and majestic cliffs that form the backdrop of our beautifully landscaped gardens.
storyParagraph1: Some stories are simply meant to be. Ours has been written through unforgettable moments, shared adventures, quiet conversations and the people who have shaped our lives.
storyParagraph2: As we begin our next chapter, there is nothing we would love more than to celebrate surrounded by our favourite people. Your presence will make our day complete.
timelineIntro: We cannot wait to celebrate with you. Here is a little glimpse into how the day will unfold.
venueTitle: A beautiful place for a beautiful day.
venueDescription: From the ceremony to the last dance, everything will take place at this special location.
dressText: We invite you to dress to impress and celebrate in style. Formal evening elegance.
unpluggedText:
On our wedding day, as the magic unfolds,
There’ll be precious moments only your camera holds.
A stolen smile, a laugh, a sweet surprise,
We’d love to relive it all through your eyes.

On the day, look out for our QR code to upload your  photographs, so we can experience the magic of our wedding through your eyes.
giftsText:
Your presence at our wedding is the greatest gift we could ask for, and we are so grateful to celebrate this special day with you.

If you would like to honour us with a gift, we would be grateful for contributions towards our future together in the form of cash or vouchers.
rsvpText: We would be honoured to celebrate with you. Please let us know whether you can attend by the RSVP date below.
footerMessage: Here's to love, laughter and happily ever after.
